principle: Retain a compatibility module only while a named current consumer still needs behavior that the V4 factual core or a downstream adapter does not provide.

assets.module: Raw / Pool / Signal Card compatibility chain
assets.interface: Raw and Pool Markdown, accepted Signal Card Markdown, compatibility_cards JSONL
assets.implementation: daily source monitor, evidence QA, Card generator, and Card gates
current_consumers: Operations Dashboard source-supply and Card funnel diagnostics
legacy Card-to-event mappings and Obsidian compatibility archives
assets.replacement: Keep original source artifacts in V4; move opportunity semantics to a downstream V4 adapter and move supply diagnostics to dedicated collection telemetry.
exit_conditions: Opportunity Map no longer reads Signal Card assets
Dashboard collection telemetry no longer reads Raw, Pool, or Card Markdown
legacy Card-to-event mappings are frozen as historical mappings
current workflows and gates have zero Card-generation requirements

assets.replacement: Split each consumer onto V4 canonical tables or dedicated collection telemetry.
exit_conditions: Opportunity Map projection remains independent from the V3 desk
supervision and health dispatch read V4 manifests and collection telemetry
compatibility Card materialization reads accepted Card assets directly
no current tool references the V3 desk interface

daily supervision stops checking the legacy graph
regression gates validate RELATION-V2.1 instead
no current tool references the graph index interface

assets.interface: relationshipGraph and relationshipDirections inside the V3 desk

agent review reads RELATION-V2.1
no current workflow treats tag or category co-occurrence as a factual relationship
